title: Reducing Safety Margin
statement: Reducing the safety margin will encourage the robot to take the turns more closely, potentially improving its ability to navigate the tight turns.
mechanism: By decreasing the safety margin, the robot will have less clearance, forcing it to navigate the turns more precisely.
